items.summary_en: The Local Denmark shares a fun language column featuring a Danish word each day. Today's word is ajourføre, which means to bring something up to date. It is a small, playful piece for curious readers.
items.summary_ko: 더 로컬 덴마크가 매일 하나의 덴마크어 단어를 소개하는 재미있는 언어 칼럼입니다. 오늘의 단어는 ajourføre로, 무언가를 최신 상태로 만든다는 뜻입니다. 호기심 많은 독자들을 위한 가볍고 유쾌한 소식입니다.
items.title_en: Danish word of the day: Ajourføre

items.raw_excerpt: Primeira parada da Estação Bienal está marcada para 9 de setembro, no Teatro Clara Nunes, no Shopping da Gávea.
items.summary_en: A book fair in Brazil is starting a traveling reading station to encourage more people to read. The first stop will be at a theater inside a shopping center on September 9. The project aims to bring books and reading events to communities across the country.
items.summary_ko: 브라질의 한 북페어가 독서 문화 확산을 위해 전국 순회 독서 스테이션을 시작합니다. 첫 번째 행사는 9월 9일 쇼핑센터 내 극장에서 열립니다. 이 프로젝트는 브라질 곳곳에 책과 독서 문화를 전파하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.title_en: Book Fair Launches New Reading Project in Brazil
items.title_ko: 북페어, 브라질 전역에 이동식 독서 스테이션 도입
items.title_original: Bienal do Livro tem novo projeto para incentivar leitura no Brasil

items.raw_excerpt: Edmonton Public Schools has cancelled all international excursions for the upcoming school year, which is part of a trend that's seen thousands of students across Canada have school trip plans cancelled or tweaked.
items.summary_en: Edmonton Public Schools has cancelled all international excursions for the upcoming school year. This is part of a trend across Canada where thousands of students have had their school trip plans cancelled or modified.

items.raw_excerpt: Travel by motorcycle in Mexico — aka "throttle therapy" — always comes with an element of adventure, even if you're not going that far.
items.summary_en: Motorcycle riding in Mexico is called throttle therapy. Riders say the fun is in the feeling of the road, not how far they go. Even short trips bring adventure and freedom.
items.summary_ko: 멕시코에서 오토바이를 타는 것을 스로틀 테라피라고 부릅니다. 라이더들은 목적지보다 도로 위의 느낌이 더 중요하다고 말합니다. 짧은 여행에서도 모험과 자유를 느낄 수 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Big eateries are giving way to a slew of smaller places dominated by creativity and drive. Here’s a quick Chacarita round-up
items.summary_en: Big restaurants are being replaced by smaller, creative places in Buenos Aires' Chacarita neighborhood. These new spots focus on passion and originality rather than size. The area has become a hot spot for food lovers seeking unique dining experiences.
items.summary_ko: 부에노스아이레스 차카리타 지역에서 큰 식당들이 작고 창의적인 장소들로 바뀌고 있다. 이러한 새로운 식당들은 규모보다는 열정과 독창성을 중시한다. 이 지역은 독특한 다이닝 경험을 찾는 미식가들의 핫플레이스가 되었다.
items.title_en: Small restaurants are serving up true grit

items.summary_en: A Valencia politician urged all residents to join a public gathering in support of Ceuta. The event aims to show warmth and solidarity with the people of Ceuta.

items.summary_en: The Local Italy explains an Italian expression for the day. 'Quanto ti devo?' means 'How much do I owe you?' and is a simple way to ask someone what you owe them.

items.raw_excerpt: If you think September marks the beginning of autumn – you are right. But the hot weather of recent months is in no hurry to leave Switzerland this year.
items.summary_en: Switzerland will get another burst of hot weather in early September. Temperatures are expected to climb well above the seasonal average. The summer-like heat will linger for several more days before cooler autumn air arrives.
items.summary_ko: 스위스가 9월 초 다시 뜨거운 날씨를 맞이할 것으로 예상됩니다. 기온이 평년 수준을 크게 웃돌 전망입니다. 선선한 가을 공기가 찾아오기 전까지 여름 같은 더위가 며칠간 이어집니다.
items.title_en: Switzerland to see one more summer heatwave this week

items.title_original: Switzerland set for one more blast of summer as temperatures spike

items.raw_excerpt: B.C. Hydro says a mini forest bigger than a Canadian football field landed ashore after drifting some 30 kilometres northwest of its last known location.
items.summary_en: A floating island bigger than a football field has been found in Williston Lake in northern British Columbia. The island, made of a mini forest, had drifted about 30 kilometres from its last known spot. B.C. Hydro says it is still watching the island closely.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다 브리티시컬럼비아주의 윌리스턴호수에서 미식축구장보다 큰 떠다니는 섬이 발견됐다. 이 섬은 작은 숲으로 이루어져 있으며, 마지막으로 알려진 위치에서 약 30킬로미터를 떠내려왔다. BC Hydro는 섬의 움직임을 계속 주시하고 있다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Lost island found drifting in B.C. lake

items.title_original: Lost island in northern B.C. lake — that appeared then disappeared — located, says B.C. Hydro

items.raw_excerpt: While it's often translated as merely the start of a new school year or the end of a holiday, this word has a deeper cultural significance.
items.summary_en: The Italian word "il rientro" has a special cultural meaning beyond just returning to school or work. It describes the moment when Italians end their summer break and go back to their daily routines. This tradition is an important part of Italian life and identity.
items.summary_ko: 이탈리아어 '일 리엔트로'는 단순히 학교나 직장으로 돌아가는 것을 넘어서는 특별한 문화적 의미를 담고 있다. 이는 이탈리아인들이 여름 휴가를 끝내고 일상으로 복귀하는 순간을 표현하는 말이다. 이 전통은 이탈리아인의 삶과 정체성에서 중요한 부분을 차지한다.
items.title_en: The deep meaning of 'il rientro' in Italian culture
items.title_ko: 이탈리아 문화의 '일 리엔트로', 그 깊은 의미
items.title_original: Why 'il rientro' means so much more in Italy than a new school year

items.raw_excerpt: Anantapur IRCS wins five Governor’s medals for outstanding contributions in membership and Social Service/CSR categories.
items.summary_en: Anantapur IRCS won five Governor's medals for their excellent work. They were honored for membership and social service. This is an award for their community help in Andhra Pradesh.
